title: Uniform fixed-element torsion bound on normal surface models
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ and let $a\in A$ be nonzero. There is an integer $N\geq0$, depending only on $(A,a)$, such that for every normal modification $X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-per-rational-surface-singularity], the $A$-submodule $H^1(X_{\rm Zar},\mathcal O_X)[a]=\{u\in H^1(X_{\rm Zar},\mathcal O_X):au=0\}$ has length at most $N$ [def-sc-zariski-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-module-length].

source.place: Tag 0AXJ (resolve-lemma-bound-a-torsion), together with equation (equation-a-torsion) identifying its cokernel with H^1[a].
